ablaze.cured_msg: The raging fire about your skin goes out.
ablaze.description: When your body is completely wrapped in flames, you will unsuprisingly find it quite painful.
ablaze.name: Burning

accentato.cured_msg: The power of the Accentato relinquishes its grasp upon you.
accentato.diagnose: transfixed by the power of the Accentato.
accentato.name: Accentato

addiction.afflicted_msg: You feel a terrible hunger grow within you.
addiction.cured_msg: Your terrible addiction seems to wane.
addiction.description: Addiction causes you to slurp your elixirs and tonics thirstily, using twice as many sips. It also causes you to eat all of a plant in your inventory, rather than just one
addiction.name: Addiction to curatives

aeon.afflicted_msg: Suddenly your movement through the time stream is slowed.
aeon.cured_msg: The curse of the Aeon wears off and you return to the normal timestream.
aeon.cures: Smoke Elm / Smoke Cinnabar and Time
aeon.description: The aeon curse slows time around you, making it impossible to do more than one thing at once, and delaying everything you do.
aeon.diagnose: afflicted with the curse of the Aeon.
aeon.name: The aeon curse

agoraphobia.afflicted_msg: Terror descends upon you and your head swims - you must find shelter!
agoraphobia.cured_msg: You can handle the idea of open spaces again.
agoraphobia.cures: Eat Lobelia / Eat Argentum and Focus Mind
agoraphobia.description: Agoraphobics cannot stand to be in wide open spaces, and seek shelter compulsively.
agoraphobia.name: Agoraphobia

airfisted.description: A windy gale will hinder their attempts to parry and the movements of Chaos orbs.
airfisted.diagnose: being plagued by a blustering gale.
airfisted.expire_msg: Clarity of form returns as the wind plaguing your mind dies down.
airfisted.name: Airfisted

amnesia.afflicted_msg: Suddenly dizzy, you clutch your head and wonder what it was you were thinking about.
amnesia.description: Amnesia makes you forget one action that you try to take.
amnesia.name: Amnesia

anorexia.afflicted_msg: The idea of eating or drinking is repulsive to you.
anorexia.cured_msg: Food is no longer repulsive to you.
anorexia.cures: Apply Epidermal To Body and Focus Mind
anorexia.description: Anorexia prevents you from eating or drinking almost anything at all.
anorexia.name: Anorexia

asphyxiating.cured_msg: Your breaths finally begin to come easier, the burning in your lungs subsiding.
asphyxiating.name: Asphyxiating

asthma.afflicted_msg: You feel a tightening sensation grow in your lungs.
asthma.cured_msg: Your bronchial tubes open up and your asthma is cured.
asthma.description: Asthma makes it impossible to smoke anything or hold your breath.
asthma.name: Asthma

betrayal.afflicted_msg: You determine that, for your own good, it is time to betray anyone and everyone.
betrayal.cured_msg: You are no longer betraying everyone.
betrayal.name: Betrayal

blackout.description: Blackout obscures your prompt and prevents you from seeing many things happening.
blackout.expire_msg: Your senses return to you as the blackout ends.
blackout.name: Blackout

blindness.afflicted_msg: Your eyes dim as you lose your sight.
blindness.description: Blindness makes it impossible to see the world around you.
blindness.name: Blindness

blistered.cured_msg: Your horribly blistered skin has recovered somewhat, your movement no longer so limited.
blistered.name: Blistered

bloodfire.cured_msg: The unnatural flames that feed upon your blood burn themselves out.
bloodfire.description: This affliction will make it impossible to apply salves while the flames persist.
bloodfire.name: Bloodfire

bound.description: When bound tightly by tied ropes, there is little you can do.
bound.name: Entanglement by tied ropes

breathless.cured_msg: You are no longer completely breathless.
breathless.name: Breathless

brokenleftarm.afflicted_msg: Your left arm breaks with a loud crack.
brokenleftarm.cured_msg: The bones in your left arm mend.
brokenleftarm.description: Having a broken left arm prevents you from using that arm in most situations.
brokenleftarm.diagnose: afflicted by a crippled left arm.
brokenleftarm.name: A broken left arm

brokenleftleg.afflicted_msg: Your left leg breaks with a loud crack.
brokenleftleg.cured_msg: The bones in your left leg mend.
brokenleftleg.description: Having a broken left leg prevents you from using that leg in most situations.
brokenleftleg.diagnose: afflicted by a crippled left leg.
brokenleftleg.name: A broken left leg

brokenrightarm.afflicted_msg: Your right arm breaks with a loud crack.
brokenrightarm.cured_msg: The bones in your right arm mend.
brokenrightarm.description: Having a broken right arm prevents you from using that arm in most situations.
brokenrightarm.diagnose: afflicted by a crippled right arm.
brokenrightarm.name: A broken right arm

brokenrightleg.afflicted_msg: Your right leg breaks with a loud crack.
brokenrightleg.cured_msg: The bones in your right leg mend.
brokenrightleg.description: Having a broken right leg prevents you from using that leg in most situations.
brokenrightleg.diagnose: afflicted by a crippled right leg.
brokenrightleg.name: A broken right leg

bruisedribs.afflicted_msg: You feel your ribs give way under the blow and a burning sensation radiates outward through your chest.
bruisedribs.name: Bruisedribs

burning.cured_msg: The raging fire about your skin goes out.
burning.description: When your body is completely wrapped in flames, you will unsuprisingly find it quite painful.
burning.name: Burning

calcifiedskull.cured_msg: Your skull's calcification abruptly ceases, leaving only a dull ache behind.
calcifiedskull.description: Calcification takes time to complete, and if not cured before then either your head shall suffer extreme damage (elevating it to the next level of damage), or if it is already at maximum head damage, you shall die instantly.
calcifiedskull.name: Calcifiedskull

calcifiedtorso.cured_msg: Your ribs' calcification abruptly ceases, leaving only a dull ache behind.
calcifiedtorso.description: Calcification takes time to complete, and if not cured before then either your torso shall suffer extreme damage (elevating it to the next level of damage), or if it is already at maximum torso damage, you shall take significant damage.
calcifiedtorso.name: Calcifiedtorso

claustrophobia.afflicted_msg: The walls close in to suffocate you - you must escape!
claustrophobia.cured_msg: Small spaces no longer frighten you.
claustrophobia.cures: Eat Lobelia / Eat Argentum and Focus Mind
claustrophobia.description: Claustrophobics cannot stand to be indoors!
claustrophobia.name: Claustrophobia

clumsiness.afflicted_msg: You gasp as your fine-tuned reflexes disappear into a haze of confusion.
clumsiness.cured_msg: Thank $(creator$)! Your clumsiness has been cured.
clumsiness.description: Clumsiness makes it hard for you to physically hit your target.
clumsiness.name: Clumsiness

coldfate.cured_msg: The overwhelming sense of cold that suffuses you abruptly lifts.
coldfate.name: Coldfate

concussion.afflicted_msg: The massive trauma to your head has damaged your skull and brain considerably.
concussion.cured_msg: Your head feels stronger and healthier.
concussion.description: Concussion makes it extremely difficult to act, bringing about frequent bouts of amnesia.
concussion.name: Concussion

condemned.cured_msg: The righteous condemnation lifts, and you breathe more easily.
condemned.description: While condemned, you may not cure ablaze, but that burning may also not be increased by paladins.
condemned.name: Condemned

conflagration.afflicted_msg: The flames plaguing you suddenly begin to rage with terrible intensity.
conflagration.cured_msg: The conflagration raging about you sputters and dies.
conflagration.description: This affliction causes significant damage for as long as the conflagration rages. The only way to be rid of it is to attempt to extinguish the flames that feed the conflagration. This is accomplished by curing all stacks of the ablaze affliction present upon you.
conflagration.name: Conflagration

confusion.afflicted_msg: Your head spins as your mind is drowned in chaos and confusion.
confusion.cured_msg: The confusion lifts from your mind and it is clear once again.
confusion.cures: Eat Ash / Eat Stannum and Focus Mind
confusion.description: Confusion extends your equilibrium recovery rates by 100%.
confusion.name: Confusion

constricted.cured_msg: You manage to wrestle the vines away from your limbs.
constricted.description: Constricted vines will disable various abilities that speed up writhing.
constricted.name: Constricted

convergence.diagnose: elemental energy is converging upon you.
convergence.name: Convergence

corruption.description: Corrupted humours affect your blood, draining mana when you bleed and health when you clot.
corruption.expire_msg: The corruption of your humours fades.
corruption.name: Corrupt humours

crackedribs.cured_msg: You can breathe easily once again.
crackedribs.description: This affliction will reduce how much health elixirs heal you for as well as giving periodic sensitivity.
crackedribs.name: Crackedribs

cremated.cured_msg: The spectral fires that wait to claim you sputter and die.
cremated.diagnose: soul seared by the might of Kkractle.
cremated.name: Cremated

crescendo.cured_msg: The building crescendo about you abruptly falls silent.
crescendo.diagnose: moving inevitably towards a grand finale.
crescendo.name: Crescendo

crushedthroat.cured_msg: Your crushed throat mends and you can draw breath easily once again.
crushedthroat.description: A crushed throat shall increase the time it takes you to recover from smoking pipes.
crushedthroat.name: Crushedthroat

daeggerimpale.description: Impalement on a daegger restricts action and causes great pain.
daeggerimpale.expire_msg: You sigh in relief as the daegger withdraws itself from your belly.
daeggerimpale.name: Impalement by a daegger

damagedhead.afflicted_msg: Your head is greatly damaged from the beating.
damagedhead.cured_msg: Your head feels stronger and healthier.
damagedhead.description: Having a damaged head will cause your mind to falter.
damagedhead.name: A damaged head

damagedleftarm.afflicted_msg: Your left arm is greatly damaged from the beating.
damagedleftarm.cured_msg: Your left arm feels stronger and healthier.
damagedleftarm.description: Having a damaged left arm prevents you from using that arm in most situations.
damagedleftarm.diagnose: has a partially damaged left arm.
damagedleftarm.name: A damaged left arm

damagedleftleg.afflicted_msg: Your left leg is greatly damaged from the beating.
damagedleftleg.cured_msg: Your left leg feels stronger and healthier.
damagedleftleg.description: Having a damaged left leg prevents you from using that leg in most situations.
damagedleftleg.diagnose: has a partially damaged left leg.
damagedleftleg.name: A damaged left leg

damagedrightarm.afflicted_msg: Your right arm is greatly damaged from the beating.
damagedrightarm.cured_msg: Your right arm feels stronger and healthier.
damagedrightarm.description: Having a damaged right arm prevents you from using that arm in most situations.
damagedrightarm.diagnose: has a partially damaged right arm.
damagedrightarm.name: A damaged right arm

damagedrightleg.afflicted_msg: Your right leg is greatly damaged from the beating.
damagedrightleg.cured_msg: Your right leg feels stronger and healthier.
damagedrightleg.description: Having a damaged right leg prevents you from using that leg in most situations.
damagedrightleg.diagnose: has a partially damaged right leg.
damagedrightleg.name: A damaged right leg

darkshade.afflicted_msg: Your vision is flooded with light, and your face suddenly reddens.
darkshade.cured_msg: No longer will the sunlight harm you.
darkshade.description: Darkshade makes even the lightest ray of sunlight extremely painful. Stay outside too long and you will surely die.
darkshade.name: An allergy to sunlight

dazed.description: Being dazed wipes out your ability to resist hypnotism.
dazed.name: Dazed

dazzled.cured_msg: Your head clears and you are no longer dazzled.
dazzled.cures: Apply Mending To Head and Time
dazzled.description: Being dazzled lowers your accuracy with certain physical attacks and halves your resistance to damage.
dazzled.expire_msg: The affects of the dazzling wear off.
dazzled.name: Dazzled

deadening.afflicted_msg: A strange fog descends upon your mind.
deadening.description: Deadening makes it easier for Telepaths to lock onto you.
deadening.name: A deadened mind

deafness.afflicted_msg: Sounds fade as you lose your hearing.
deafness.description: Deafness stops you from hearing anything.
deafness.name: Deafness

deathsickness.afflicted_msg: An unnatural chill sweeps through your body, a numbing sensation radiating outward from your heart and into every limb.
deathsickness.cured_msg: The unnatural chill pervading your body abruptly lifts.
deathsickness.diagnose: Labouring beneath the bane of life.
deathsickness.name: Deathsickness

deepsleep.description: A deep sleep is one from which you will never naturally wake.
deepsleep.name: Deepsleep

degenerate.cured_msg: You suddenly feel much less weak, strength flooding back into your limbs.
degenerate.name: Degenerate

dehydrated.description: Reduces your resistance to fire-based damage.
dehydrated.name: Dehydrated

dementia.afflicted_msg: You look about yourself, frenzied and wild-eyed.
dementia.cured_msg: Sanity returns to you and you are no longer demented.
dementia.cures: Eat Ash / Eat Stannum and Focus Mind
dementia.description: Demented persons struggle to see reality as it truly is, often seeing things that are not there.
dementia.name: Dementia

demonstain.description: A demonic stain on your being reduces all of your statistics by one point.
demonstain.name: A demonic stain

depression.cured_msg: Maybe things aren't so bad after all.
depression.description: Every time you suffer a symptom from a phobia or madness, you will take health and mana damage.
depression.name: Depression

diminished.cured_msg: The enfeeblement of your spirit lifts.
diminished.name: Diminished

disfigurement.afflicted_msg: You feel ugliness radiating from you.
disfigurement.cured_msg: You no longer will inspire disloyalty among friends.
disfigurement.description: Disloyalty, often caused by disfigurement, makes creatures loyal to you consider you a beastly enemy.
disfigurement.name: Disloyalty

disloyalty.afflicted_msg: You feel ugliness radiating from you.
disloyalty.cured_msg: You no longer will inspire disloyalty among friends.
disloyalty.description: Disloyalty, often caused by disfigurement, makes creatures loyal to you consider you a beastly enemy.
disloyalty.name: Disloyalty

disrupted.description: Being disrupted will keep you permanently off of equilibrium.
disrupted.name: Disrupted

dissonance.afflicted_msg: You feel your body begin to vibrate in tune with the disruptive harmonies.
dissonance.description: Aural dissonance causes defences to slowly peel away from you.
dissonance.name: Dissonance

dizziness.afflicted_msg: Your mind swims as dizziness overtakes you.
dizziness.cures: Eat Goldenseal / Eat Plumbum and Focus Mind
dizziness.description: Dizziness makes it quite hard to walk without falling over.
dizziness.name: Dizziness

earworm.cured_msg: The endlessly playing song in your mind falls silent.
earworm.name: Earworm

empoweredloshre.cured_msg: The sapping power of the Loshre rune leaves you.
empoweredloshre.description: Eating ginseng or ferrum while suffering this affliction will cause your health and mana to be drained.
empoweredloshre.diagnose: being sapped by the power of the Loshre rune.
empoweredloshre.name: Empoweredloshre

empoweredmannaz.cured_msg: The vitiating power of the Mannaz rune leaves you.
empoweredmannaz.description: Someone with this affliction does not regenerate mana passively.
empoweredmannaz.diagnose: vitiated by the power of the Mannaz rune.
empoweredmannaz.name: Empoweredmannaz

enlightenment.cured_msg: The alien and strange visions leave you, and the Chaos that permeated your mind lessens.
enlightenment.description: Enlightenment opens your mind to occult revelations, and will make certain mental insanities permanent until you die.
enlightenment.diagnose: understanding the occult mysteries and nature of the universe as seen by $(gname$).
enlightenment.name: Enlightenment

enmesh.cured_msg: You manage to free yourself of the bonds clinging to your limbs.
enmesh.diagnose: unable to parry due to being partially bound.
enmesh.name: Enmesh

ensorcelled.description: This affliction will cause various movement attempts to fail on occasion.
ensorcelled.expire_msg: A sudden flush of heat drives out a chill that you didn't realise was there until it is gone; your limbs tingle, and you feel unburdened.
ensorcelled.name: Ensorcelled

entangled.description: Entangled in ropes restricts most forms of movement and action.
entangled.name: Entanglement by ropes

epilepsy.cures: Eat Goldenseal / Eat Plumbum and Focus Mind
epilepsy.description: Epilepsy causes you to fit intermittently, using balance.
epilepsy.name: Epilepsy

fear.afflicted_msg: A terrible fear comes over you.
fear.description: Fear is a crippling panic resulting in your running around uncontrollably.
fear.name: Fear

flamefisted.description: This fiery aura immediately burns away any aura of rebounding.
flamefisted.diagnose: suffused with an aura of fire.
flamefisted.expire_msg: A trickle of sweat cools your scorched skin as the raging blaze abates.
flamefisted.name: Flamefisted

flushings.afflicted_msg: Your skin begins to prickle uncomfortably.
flushings.cured_msg: The prickling in your skin fades and you feel blessedly cool.
flushings.name: Flushings

fratricide.afflicted_msg: Something subtle and yet insidious overcomes you.
fratricide.cured_msg: You rid yourself of the insidious venom plaguing you.
fratricide.description: Grants major negative poison resist and causes hypnotic impulses to relapse a short time after being first introduced.
fratricide.name: Fratricide

freezing.afflicted_msg: Your body slows as it freezes in the extreme cold.
freezing.cured_msg: Though still shivering, you are no longer frozen solid.
freezing.description: Being frozen solid, you will find it much slower to move.
freezing.name: A frozen body

frostbite.afflicted_msg: A pervasive numbness begins to spread throughout your extremities.
frostbite.cured_msg: The pervasive numbness in your extremities fades.
frostbite.description: While suffering from frostbite, the next time you are frozen if you possess the insulation defence it will be stripped and you will be struck with the freezing attack directly. Your frostbite will fade when this occurs.
frostbite.name: Frostbite

frozen.afflicted_msg: Your body slows as it freezes in the extreme cold.
frozen.cured_msg: Though still shivering, you are no longer frozen solid.
frozen.description: Being frozen solid, you will find it much slower to move.
frozen.name: A frozen body

fulminated.afflicted_msg: Your nerve endings become electrified and you begin to tremble.
fulminated.cured_msg: You are no longer suffering from the ravages of fulminous energy.
fulminated.description: Successful attempts to focus your mind to cure an affliction will cause you to be struck down with paralysis.
fulminated.name: Fulminated

generosity.afflicted_msg: Why, you ask yourself, are you so privileged when others are so needy.
generosity.cured_msg: Ahhhh. The freedom to be stingy again!
generosity.description: Generosity causes you to give away your material possessions.
generosity.name: Generosity

grievouswounds.afflicted_msg: Blood flows freely from a grievous wound.
grievouswounds.cured_msg: The flow of blood stops as your wounds close.
grievouswounds.description: While you can fight through a single wound, even the most stalwart adventurer will succumb to enough of them.
grievouswounds.name: Grievously wounded

guilt.afflicted_msg: A terrible guilt descends upon you.
guilt.description: This affliction causes mental focusing to deliver a mental affliction.
guilt.name: Guilt

haemophilia.afflicted_msg: You sense a subtle change deep within.
haemophilia.cured_msg: Your blood regains its ability to clot.
haemophilia.description: Haemophiliacs find it impossible to clot their blood.
haemophilia.name: Haemophilia

hallucinations.afflicted_msg: An unseen being takes you to one side and whispers conspiratorially to you.
hallucinations.cured_msg: Your hallucinations cease to plague you.
hallucinations.cures: Eat Ash / Eat Stannum and Focus Mind
hallucinations.description: Hallucinations cause you to see things that are not there, and occasionally act strangely because of your visions.
hallucinations.name: Hallucinations

hamstrung.description: A crippled hamstring greatly impedes one's ability to walk for a short time.
hamstrung.expire_msg: You feel the tightness in your hamstring subside, allowing free movement once again.
hamstrung.name: Hamstrung

hatred.afflicted_msg: An all-consuming hatred for everyone and everything suffuses you.
hatred.cured_msg: Your total loathing for everything fades.
hatred.description: You shall consider everyone an enemy.
hatred.diagnose: inspired to great heights of loathing.
hatred.name: Hatred

healthleech.afflicted_msg: Your health begins to drain away.
healthleech.cured_msg: Your aching, pain-wracked body is soothed and calmed.
healthleech.name: Healthleech

heartseed.cured_msg: The remedy burns through your chest, eliminating the spreading tendrils of a virulent heartseed.
heartseed.description: An elemental heart seed rapidly grows within your chest until it bursts out, ensuring a grisly death.
heartseed.diagnose: plagued by the rapid growth of a heartseed.
heartseed.name: Heartseed

hecatecurse.description: Prevents curing of the whispering madness affliction for its duration.
hecatecurse.diagnose: Cursed with the power of Hecate.
hecatecurse.expire_msg: The crazed whispering fades from your mind.
hecatecurse.name: Hecatecurse

hellsight.cured_msg: Thankfully, the visions of Hell have left you.
hellsight.description: This affliction causes you to see into Hell itself, which periodically causes a variety of afflictions.
hellsight.expire_msg: The hellish visions that haunted you recede into the darkness from whence they came.
hellsight.name: Hellsight

hindered.description: Being hindered by the forests may impede your movement.
hindered.name: Hindered

homunculusmercury.cured_msg: Eating is suddenly less difficult again.
homunculusmercury.name: Homunculusmercury

horror.afflicted_msg: Composure deserts you; it is just too much!
horror.cured_msg: You draw a relieved breath as the unnatural terror finally abates.
horror.description: While horrified, you may not cure fear.
horror.name: Horror

hypersomnia.afflicted_msg: An urge to visit the Goddess of Dreams overcomes you.
hypersomnia.cured_msg: You feel a bit more alert and awake.
hypersomnia.description: Hypersomniacs find sleep an urge very hard to resist.
hypersomnia.name: Hypersomnia

hypochondria.afflicted_msg: A terrible sense of unease comes over you.
hypochondria.cured_msg: My, you feel healthier than you have in years.
hypochondria.description: Hypochondriacs often think they are suffering from afflictions they do not have.
hypochondria.name: Hypochondria

hypothermia.cured_msg: Though still frozen, you feel some slight remnants of heat returning to you.
hypothermia.name: Hypothermia

icebound.afflicted_msg: Frost covers your limbs, restricting your actions.
icebound.cured_msg: Your limbs thaw, freeing you from your frozen bonds.
icebound.description: Being restricted by the frozen bonds is restrictive on any actions you wish to make, including the use of curative arts.
icebound.name: Restricted by frozen bonds

icefisted.description: This layer of frost prevents you from touching your tattoos.
icefisted.diagnose: covered in a rime of frost.
icefisted.expire_msg: The rime of ice covering your body cracks and falls away in glassy shards.
icefisted.name: Icefisted

impaled.description: Impalement by a weapon restricts movement and causes massive bleeding.
impaled.name: Impaled

impatience.afflicted_msg: You shuffle your feet noisily, suddenly bored.
impatience.description: Impatience reduces the amount of mana restored by half and prevents you from focusing your mind.
impatience.name: Impatience

indifference.afflicted_msg: You find yourself indifferent to the raging flow of battle.
indifference.cured_msg: Your blood surges as the rage of battle returns to you.
indifference.description: Being indifferent as to the raging flow of battle, you will be unable to use any battlerage attacks or generate any battlerage.
indifference.diagnose: indifferent to the rage of battle
indifference.expire_msg: Your indifference to the rage of battle clears.
indifference.name: Indifference

inquisition.cured_msg: Clarity returns to your mind as the echoing accusations fade from memory.
inquisition.description: A holy inquisition can cause a variety of effects ranging from lower mental regeneration to finding it impossible to escape the sight of Hell. It cures once the victim has rid themselves of both guilt and spiritburn afflictions, and is no longer prone.
inquisition.name: Inquisition

insomnia.afflicted_msg: You suddenly feel incapable of falling asleep.
insomnia.cured_msg: Your mind relaxes and you feel as if you could sleep.
insomnia.description: Insomnia makes it very difficult to fall asleep.
insomnia.name: Insomnia

internalbleeding.description: This severe internal injury causes massive bleeding.
internalbleeding.expire_msg: Your pulse strengthens as your damaged arteries clot over and your internal bleeding ceases.
internalbleeding.name: Massive internal bleeding

isolation.description: If your mind has been isolated by a telepath, no-one will hear you speak on telepathic channels.
isolation.name: Mind isolation

itching.afflicted_msg: A terrible urge to itch yourself bloody comes over you.
itching.description: Itching causes periodic loss of balance as you scratch yourself furiously.
itching.name: Itching

justice.afflicted_msg: A set of scales appears over your head and one side quickly descends, as you feel an aura of justice surround you.
justice.cured_msg: The curse of justice leaves you.
justice.description: The justice curse causes any damaging attack by you against the afflictor to be partially returned to you.
justice.diagnose: surrounded by the aura of justice.
justice.name: Justice

kaisurge.description: This affliction prevents mounting and adds a small extension to the broken limb penalty on tumble.
kaisurge.diagnose: greatly inhibited by a recent surge of Kai energy.
kaisurge.name: Kaisurge

kkractlebrand.afflicted_msg: The mark upon your brow bursts into flame, a singular point of agony that threatens to consume you.
kkractlebrand.cured_msg: The burning brand upon your brow fades, leaving only tender flesh as a warning.
kkractlebrand.description: The brand of Kkractle reduces your fire resistance. It burns more fiercely the more you are struck by a Fire Lord, and can be detonated to unleash a devastating explosion of fire.
kkractlebrand.diagnose: marked by the wrath of Kkractle.
kkractlebrand.name: Kkractlebrand

laceratedthroat.afflicted_msg: A torrent of blood erupts from your throat as the thorn-laden vines tear at the already wounded flesh.
laceratedthroat.cured_msg: The flow of blood slows as the gaping wound in your throat partially mends.
laceratedthroat.description: A lacerated throat makes vocal work difficult and greatly reduces the efficacy of health and mana elixirs.
laceratedthroat.diagnose: bleeding profusely from a lacerated throat.
laceratedthroat.name: Laceratedthroat

lapsingconsciousness.afflicted_msg: You feel your brain begin to falter.
lapsingconsciousness.cured_msg: You feel your brain recover, no longer always on the verge of falling unconscious.
lapsingconsciousness.description: Lapsing consciousness causes you to periodically fall unconscious.
lapsingconsciousness.name: Lapses in consciousness

latched.afflicted_msg: You feel suddenly weak, your limbs trembling and bile rising.
latched.cured_msg: Warmth floods back into your limbs, and you feel suddenly vital.
latched.name: Latched

lethargy.afflicted_msg: You feel your energy robbed from you as lethargy overtakes you.
lethargy.cured_msg: The lethargy evaporates, leaving you full of energy.
lethargy.description: Lethargy leaves you feeling physically drained, making movement and action harder.
lethargy.name: Lethargy

lightbind.description: This affliction will cause various movement attempts to fail on occasion.
lightbind.diagnose: bound by chains of golden light.
lightbind.expire_msg: The golden chains of light that bind you dissipate.
lightbind.name: Lightbind

loneliness.afflicted_msg: You glance nervously around the room.
loneliness.cures: Eat Lobelia / Eat Argentum and Focus Mind
loneliness.description: Lonely people simply must find company, and will move around until they do so!
loneliness.name: Loneliness

lovers.cured_msg: You shake your head, wondering what you ever saw in $(gname$).
lovers.cures: Eat Bellwort / Eat Cuprum and Focus Mind
lovers.description: The lover's curse prevents you from attacking the person with whom you are in love.
lovers.name: The lover's curse

lovestruck.cured_msg: Your strange fixation on all those that surround you abruptly lifts.
lovestruck.name: Lovestruck

manaleech.afflicted_msg: Your mana begins to drain away.
manaleech.cured_msg: Your rapidly weakening mind is stabilized.
manaleech.description: Mana leech causes your mental faculties to slowly drain away.
manaleech.name: Manaleech

mangledhead.afflicted_msg: Your skull splits and caves in as your head takes serious damage.
mangledhead.cured_msg: Your head is greatly healed, but still damaged.
mangledhead.description: Having a mangled head will cause your mind to falter.
mangledhead.name: A mangled head

mangledleftarm.afflicted_msg: To your horror, your left arm has been mutilated beyond repair by ordinary means.
mangledleftarm.cured_msg: Your left arm is greatly healed, but still damaged.
mangledleftarm.description: Having a mangled left arm prevents you from using that arm in most situations.
mangledleftarm.name: A mangled left arm

mangledleftleg.afflicted_msg: To your horror, your left leg has been mutilated beyond repair by ordinary means.
mangledleftleg.cured_msg: Your left leg is greatly healed, but still damaged.
mangledleftleg.description: Having a mangled left leg prevents you from using that leg in most situations.
mangledleftleg.name: A mangled left leg

mangledrightarm.afflicted_msg: To your horror, your right arm has been mutilated beyond repair by ordinary means.
mangledrightarm.cured_msg: Your right arm is greatly healed, but still damaged.
mangledrightarm.description: Having a mangled right arm prevents you from using that arm in most situations.
mangledrightarm.name: A mangled right arm

mangledrightleg.afflicted_msg: To your horror, your right leg has been mutilated beyond repair by ordinary means.
mangledrightleg.cured_msg: Your right leg is greatly healed, but still damaged.
mangledrightleg.description: Having a mangled right leg prevents you from using that leg in most situations.
mangledrightleg.name: A mangled right leg

masochism.afflicted_msg: An odd sensation descends upon you.
masochism.cures: Eat Lobelia / Eat Argentum and Focus Mind
masochism.description: Masochism causes you to periodically harm yourself.
masochism.name: Masochism

mildtrauma.afflicted_msg: Your torso is greatly damaged from the beating.
mildtrauma.cured_msg: Your torso feels stronger and healthier.
mildtrauma.description: Having a damaged torso will cause you to bleed profusely.
mildtrauma.name: Mild internal trauma

mindclamp.description: A clamped mind reduces your health and mental strength by approximately one fifth.
mindclamp.name: A clamped mind

mindravaged.cured_msg: Your ravaged mind has recovered somewhat, though phantom pain still pulses at your temples.
mindravaged.description: A ravaged mind will leave you vulnerable to psychic assault.
mindravaged.diagnose: Ravaged in mind by psionic power.
mindravaged.name: Mindravaged

muddled.cured_msg: Your thoughts seem less sluggish and slow.
muddled.description: This affliction causes mental maladies to work against you with greater potency, such as by boosting the rate of stupidity firing or the likeliness that you will be hit by dizziness.
muddled.name: Muddled

mycalium.afflicted_msg: Your thoughts cloud as a strange sense of displacement overcomes you.
mycalium.cured_msg: Your thoughts suddenly crystalise, the insidious whispers falling abruptly silent.
mycalium.diagnose: plagued with a corruption of the mind.
mycalium.name: Mycalium

nausea.afflicted_msg: A sense of extreme nausea washes over you.
nausea.name: Nausea

numbedleftarm.diagnose: your left arm is completely numb.
numbedleftarm.expire_msg: Feeling returns to your left arm.
numbedleftarm.name: Numbedleftarm

numbedrightarm.diagnose: your right arm is completely numb.
numbedrightarm.expire_msg: Feeling returns to your right arm.
numbedrightarm.name: Numbedrightarm

pacified.afflicted_msg: A sense of deep inner calm descends on you.
pacified.cured_msg: The unnatural calm that filled you lifts abruptly from you.
pacified.cures: Eat Bellwort / Eat Cuprum and Focus Mind
pacified.description: Pacification makes it impossible to do any aggressive actions.
pacified.name: Pacified

palpatarfeed.cured_msg: The maggots infesting you wither and die.
palpatarfeed.description: This affliction will periodically afflict with healthleech until it fades.
palpatarfeed.diagnose: Being fed on by the maggots of Palpatar.
palpatarfeed.name: Palpatarfeed

paralysis.afflicted_msg: A prickly stinging overcomes your body, fading away into numbness.
paralysis.cured_msg: Your muscles unlock; you are no longer paralysed.
paralysis.description: Paralysis locks up all of your muscles, preventing active physical movements.
paralysis.name: Paralysis

paranoia.cured_msg: Aaaahhh. No one is out to get you after all.
paranoia.cures: Eat Ash / Eat Stannum and Focus Mind
paranoia.description: Paranoid people consider everyone an enemy.
paranoia.name: Paranoia

parasite.afflicted_msg: You feel your strength being leeched away.
parasite.cured_msg: The leeching of your strength comes to an end.
parasite.description: This affliction will cause all of your natural regeneration to heal the person who afflicted you instead, and will delay the effects of the speed elixir.
parasite.name: Parasite

peace.afflicted_msg: Your will to harm anything leaves you.
peace.cured_msg: The unnatural feeling of peace leaves you.
peace.cures: Eat Bellwort / Eat Cuprum and Focus Mind
peace.description: While peaced, you will find it almost impossible to perform aggressive actions.
peace.expire_msg: The unnatural peace lifts from your heart.
peace.name: Peace

penitence.description: If you have been forced to perform penance for your crimes, any Devoted priest will earn more Devotion from killing you.
penitence.name: Penitence

petrified.cured_msg: Sensation returns to you as the petrification ends.
petrified.name: Petrified

phlogisticated.description: Phlogisitication temporarily renders your body unable to benefit from irid moss or potash when you use equilibrium.
phlogisticated.name: Phlogisticated

pinshot.cured_msg: The arrow through your foot finally comes free, allowing you to move normally once again.
pinshot.description: This affliction will cause various movement attempts to fail on occasion.
pinshot.name: Pinshot

pressure.cured_msg: The oppressive pressure weighing down on you lifts.
pressure.name: Pressure

prone.description: Being knocked prone can cause a lot of your options to be limited.
prone.name: Prone

pyramides.afflicted_msg: Your heart skips a beat, then begins to pound.
pyramides.cured_msg: The burning in your veins abruptly fades.
pyramides.name: Pyramides

pyre.cured_msg: The terrible burning within your chest is replaced by a soothing cool.
pyre.description: While pyre is active, ablaze may not be cured below the intensity of the pyre's own stacks.
pyre.name: Pyre

rebbies.afflicted_msg: You feel... odd. So very odd.
rebbies.diagnose: your skin is secreting a vile slime.
rebbies.name: Rebbies

recklessness.afflicted_msg: None may stand in your way! You are invincible!
recklessness.cured_msg: Prudence rules your psyche once again.
recklessness.cures: Eat Lobelia / Eat Argentum and Focus Mind
recklessness.description: Recklessness makes you think you are completely unharmed and practically invincible.
recklessness.name: Recklessness

reeling.cured_msg: You recover yourself, no longer reeling wildly off balance.
reeling.name: Reeling

retribution.afflicted_msg: A terrible sense of foreboding descends upon you.
retribution.cured_msg: The terrible sense of foreboding lifts.
retribution.description: Sipping mana while under the effects of retribution will cause you to lose half of what you gained in health.
retribution.name: Retribution

revealed.afflicted_msg: A strange dust settles upon your form, illuminating your outline.
revealed.diagnose: revealed by the power of a star sigil.
revealed.name: Revealed

sandfever.cured_msg: Your fever finally breaks, the terrible burning retreating.
sandfever.name: Sandfever

scalded.cured_msg: The terrible burning of your skin fades.
scalded.description: Increases the recovery time of applying salves.
scalded.name: Scalded

scrambledbrains.afflicted_msg: Your brains feel scrambled by the impact.
scrambledbrains.cured_msg: Your brains no longer feel so scrambled.
scrambledbrains.description: This affliction will make it impossible for you to naturally reject mental locks upon your person, as well as delaying the cure aspect of any attempt to focus your mind.
scrambledbrains.diagnose: your brains have been scrambled by a great impact.
scrambledbrains.name: Scrambledbrains

scytherus.afflicted_msg: You feel light headed and dizzy.
scytherus.description: Scytherus causes any venoms you get affected by to relapse after a short delay.
scytherus.name: Thin blood

selarnia.cured_msg: You feel the barrier that separated you from your animal consciousness has dissipated.
selarnia.description: Selarnia makes it very difficult to maintain a bond to animal spirits.
selarnia.diagnose: losing the bond with the animal spirits.
selarnia.name: A severed bond with the spirits

sensitivity.afflicted_msg: A prickly, stinging sensation spreads through your body.
sensitivity.description: Sensitive skin increases the damage of any painful attacks you receive.
sensitivity.name: Sensitivity

serioustrauma.afflicted_msg: Your internal organs have taken serious damage.
serioustrauma.cured_msg: Your torso is greatly healed, but still damaged.
serioustrauma.description: Serious internal trauma causes great bleeding.
serioustrauma.name: Serious internal trauma

shadowmadness.afflicted_msg: Your sanity begins to escape you.
shadowmadness.description: This affliction will increased the mana cost and recovery time of focus, as well as periodically afflicting the affected person with various madnesses.
shadowmadness.name: Shadowmadness

shivering.cured_msg: Your body warms up and you stop shivering.
shivering.description: Shivering causes you to intermittently lose equilibrium.
shivering.name: The shivers

shyness.cured_msg: Your shyness has been cured. You can now face the world boldly.
shyness.cures: Eat Goldenseal / Eat Plumbum and Focus Mind
shyness.description: Shyness causes you to run away at the sight of other people.
shyness.name: Shyness

silenced.cured_msg: Sound suddenly rushes in, the terrible pervading silence gone as swiftly as it came.
silenced.name: Silenced

silver.description: This shining silvery glow will negate any shroud concealing your actions.
silver.expire_msg: The shimmering silver light about you fades away.
silver.name: Silver

skullfractures.cured_msg: The pounding in your head disappears.
skullfractures.description: This affliction will extend recovery time when sipping health elixirs and give periodic nausea.
skullfractures.name: Skullfractures

slashedthroat.afflicted_msg: Blood sprays forth as the thorn-laden vine rips a deep wound in your throat.
slashedthroat.cured_msg: The bleeding gash in your throat closes up completely.
slashedthroat.description: A slashed throat makes vocal work difficult and reduces the efficacy of health and mana elixirs.
slashedthroat.name: Slashedthroat

sleeping.afflicted_msg: You feel incredibly tired, and fall asleep immediately.
sleeping.cured_msg: You open your eyes and yawn mightily.
sleeping.description: While asleep, you can do little but dream, and wake up.
sleeping.expire_msg: You open your eyes and stretch languidly, feeling deliciously well-rested.
sleeping.name: Sleeping

slickness.afflicted_msg: You notice that your sweat glands have begun to rapidly secrete a foul, oily substance.
slickness.cured_msg: Your glands cease their oily secretion.
slickness.cures: Smoke Valerian / Smoke Realgar and Eat Bloodroot / Eat Magnesium
slickness.description: Slickness coats your skin in oily secretions, blocking any attempt to apply salves or balms.
slickness.name: Slickness

slimeobscure.description: This affliction will obscure random cure messages.
slimeobscure.expire_msg: You rid yourself of the slime coating your skin.
slimeobscure.name: Slimeobscure

snared.cured_msg: You manage to disentangle yourself from the rope trap which had snared your ankles.
snared.diagnose: tangled up by a rope snare.
snared.name: Snared

solarburn.cured_msg: Your skin ceases its painful tingling.
solarburn.name: Solarburn

speechless.cured_msg: You find your tongue will once more obey your will to speak.
speechless.name: Speechless

spiritburn.afflicted_msg: Your skin begins to grow uncomfortably hot.
spiritburn.cured_msg: The uncomfortable heat suffusing you fades.
spiritburn.description: This affliction causes the flames of the ablaze affliction to burn the soul as well as the body, draining mana in addition to health.
spiritburn.name: Spiritburn

stridulating.afflicted_msg: Your body begins to vibrate in sympathetic resonance with a stridulation vibration.
stridulating.cured_msg: You cease vibrating in tune with stridulation vibrations.
stridulating.name: Stridulating

stupidity.afflicted_msg: Hmmmm. Why must everything be so difficult to figure out?
stupidity.cured_msg: You aren't such a complete idiot anymore.
stupidity.cures: Eat Goldenseal / Eat Plumbum and Focus Mind
stupidity.description: Stupidity makes it harder to do exactly what you want to do. You may fumble some actions.
stupidity.name: Stupidity

stuttering.afflicted_msg: The thought of speech seems difficult all of a sudden.
stuttering.cured_msg: Your tongue will finally obey your commands properly.
stuttering.cures: Apply Epidermal To Head and Focus Mind
stuttering.description: With a stutter, you can barely speak a word coherently.
stuttering.name: Stuttering

succumbed.cured_msg: Your thoughts clear, your pulse steadies; love's madness has left you... for now.
succumbed.name: Succumbed

temperedcholeric.description: A tempered choleric humour causes random curing abilities to have a chance to fail.
temperedcholeric.diagnose: your choleric humour has been tempered a total of $=(type$) times.
temperedcholeric.expire_msg: Your choleric humour drains back to normal levels.
temperedcholeric.name: A tempered choleric humour

temperedmelancholic.description: A tempered melancholic humour reduces the efficacy of irid moss and potash.
temperedmelancholic.diagnose: your melancholic humour has been tempered a total of $=(type$) times.
temperedmelancholic.expire_msg: Your melancholic humour drains back to normal levels.
temperedmelancholic.name: A tempered melancholic humour

temperedphlegmatic.description: A tempered phlegmatic humour fills your lungs with phlegm when you try to smoke.
temperedphlegmatic.diagnose: your phlegmatic humour has been tempered a total of $=(type$) times.
temperedphlegmatic.expire_msg: Your phlegmatic humour drains back to normal levels.
temperedphlegmatic.name: A tempered phlegmatic humour

temperedsanguine.description: A tempered sanguine humour causes bleeding to increase over time.
temperedsanguine.diagnose: your sanguine humour has been tempered a total of $=(type$) times.
temperedsanguine.expire_msg: Your sanguine humour drains back to normal levels.
temperedsanguine.name: A tempered sanguine humour

tenderskin.afflicted_msg: Your skin is left tender and raw from the flames.
tenderskin.cured_msg: Your skin is no longer so tender.
tenderskin.description: This affliction causes applying salves to cause mana damage, more so for restoration applies.
tenderskin.name: Tenderskin

tension.cured_msg: You suddenly find the air much easier to breathe.
tension.name: Tension

timeflux.diagnose: suffering from a distorted perception of time.
timeflux.expire_msg: You feel less sluggish all of a sudden.
timeflux.name: Timeflux

timeloop.afflicted_msg: The world seems to grow distorted around you, as if through a thick fog.
timeloop.cured_msg: You break out of the feedback loop.
timeloop.description: All instillations via Shadowmancy directed at you will be twice as effective, delivering two afflictions instead of one.
timeloop.name: Timeloop

tonguetied.afflicted_msg: Your tongue twists and writhes in your mouth as if with a will of its own.
tonguetied.cured_msg: Your tongue stops its mad twisting.
tonguetied.description: Being tongue tied will make you unable to cure the stuttering affliction until you first cure this affliction.
tonguetied.name: A tongue tied

torntendons.cured_msg: The burning in your lower legs fades away.
torntendons.description: This affliction will make movement attempts fail as well as giving periodic clumsiness.
torntendons.name: Torntendons

trueblind.description: This blindness is so potent that not even the mindseye tattoo can function to counteract it.
trueblind.diagnose: suffering from extreme loss of vision.
trueblind.expire_msg: Your vision gradually returns to you.
trueblind.name: Trueblind

unconsciousness.afflicted_msg: Your legs collapse from under you and consciousness leaves you as you pass out.
unconsciousness.cured_msg: You regain consciousness with a start.
unconsciousness.description: Unconsciousness is a highly debilitating affliction, preventing you from doing almost anything, though it is temporary and rarely lasts more than a few seconds.
unconsciousness.name: Unconsciousness

unweavingbody.cured_msg: The unnatural weakness of your muscles suddenly fades, your vitality resurging.
unweavingbody.description: An unwoven body will sap your health as it progresses.
unweavingbody.name: Unweavingbody

unweavingmind.cured_msg: Your thoughts suddenly become crystal clear, the haze over your thoughts vanishing without a trace.
unweavingmind.description: An unwoven mind will sap your mana as it progresses.
unweavingmind.name: Unweavingmind

unweavingspirit.cured_msg: You feel your fundamental essence stabilise, your spiritual energy surging with new strength.
unweavingspirit.description: An unwoven spirit will make this affliction progressively harder to cure.
unweavingspirit.name: Unweavingspirit

vertigo.afflicted_msg: The idea of heights makes you queasy suddenly.
vertigo.cures: Eat Lobelia / Eat Argentum and Focus Mind
vertigo.description: People with vertigo cannot bear to leave the ground.
vertigo.name: Vertigo

vinewreathed.description: These flailing vines will make it impossible to parry a Viridian's thorn rends.
vinewreathed.expire_msg: The vines flailing about your form recede.
vinewreathed.name: Wreathed in vines

vitiated.description: Being vitiated reduces your strength and dexterity by two points.
vitiated.name: Vitiated

vitrified.description: Vitrification causes your skin to partially become glass, which will result in bleeding when you do anything which uses your balance.
vitrified.expire_msg: The glass shards embedded in your skin revert to flesh.
vitrified.name: Vitrified

voidfisted.description: Surrounded by the void, curative herbs may not be as effective.
voidfisted.expire_msg: The empty grasp of the void retreats, and you breathe more easily.
voidfisted.name: Voidfisted

voyria.cured_msg: Mercifully, the voyria venom has been cleansed from your body.
voyria.description: Voyria is a deadly venom that quickly causes death if not treated.
voyria.name: Voyria

waterbonds.cured_msg: The tendrils of water that bind you splash into an icy puddle at your feet as they disperse.
waterbonds.name: Waterbonds

weakenedmind.cured_msg: The power of Rixil fades from your mind.
weakenedmind.description: Being weakened in mind will cause the next attempt to focus your mind to have a significantly increased recovery time.
weakenedmind.name: Weakenedmind

weariness.afflicted_msg: Your limbs grow heavy and you groan feebly.
weariness.cured_msg: Your limbs strengthen and you feel stronger.
weariness.description: Weariness increases the rate at which you use endurance, decreases damage from cutting or blunt attacks you perform, and makes certain delayed movements take longer.
weariness.name: Weariness

webbed.description: Being webbed is restrictive on any actions you wish to make.
webbed.name: Entanglement by webs

whisperingmadness.afflicted_msg: You feel an invisible claw brush the back of your skull.
whisperingmadness.cured_msg: The whispering in your mind subsides.
whisperingmadness.description: Whispering madness increases the balance cost of focusing your mind by 60% and slightly lowers the affliction threshold required to become enlightened.
whisperingmadness.name: Whispering madness

woeconstrained.cured_msg: You are no longer constrained to war by the tales of Woe.
woeconstrained.diagnose: constrained to war by the tales of Woe.
woeconstrained.name: Woeconstrained

wristfractures.cured_msg: You feel bones snapping back into place in your arms.
wristfractures.description: This affliction will give periodic lethargy.
wristfractures.name: Wristfractures
